title: Robot: inverse dynamics in KinematicChain and Robot, the dynamic compensation of the joint control
author: Claude-JG
description: The joint control of Robot compensates gravity only (compensation='static'); the feed-forward of the inverse dynamics with the planned velocities and accelerations, which leaves the PD control the errors only, is missing (RG19.4.2), and KinematicChain has no inertias. Decided: KinematicChain gets the inertia tensors and InverseDynamics(q, q_t, q_tt) by the recursive Newton-Euler algorithm in C++, Robot.InverseDynamics the same in Python; SetControl(trajectory, compensation='dynamic') for both models.
releaseNotes: KinematicChain(..., inertias) and KinematicChain.InverseDynamics(q, q_t, q_tt) of exudyn.cUtilities give the joint torques and forces of the inverse dynamics by the recursive Newton-Euler algorithm (about 2 us for 6 links); Robot.InverseDynamics is the same in Python, and Robot.GetKinematicChain passes the inertias of the links. Robot.SetControl(trajectory, compensation='dynamic') adds them as feed-forward to the PD control of the kinematic tree and of the redundant coordinate model.
